agent: Claude Code (CLAUDE.md, this repository) — WP-03a verification: item (v) V10 caller-routes-every-ending gap (last of the original 8 items)
summary_for_principal:
This closes the last of the original eight checklist items (as with the last two, the original investigation's detail was lost to context compression, so I re-verified from scratch).

The spec makes two promises about calling one process from within another: the caller must account for every possible outcome, and must actually route every one of them somewhere. Only the first half was checked, and only for one of two ways to make such a call — a self-contained embedded process (fixed last time) was skipped entirely. Fixed that.

The second promise — outcomes actually get routed, not just accounted for — is genuinely unimplemented anywhere, and I've deliberately not built it. Doing so would require guessing which field of a tool's output carries the outcome, something the spec never states. I've written up what the spec would need to say before this could be built honestly.

Full test suite: 382 passed, 2 new.

Numbered actions:
1. Nothing needs deciding right now.
2. The original checklist is fully closed. Two larger, unrelated pieces of an earlier item remain.
